label: Test selective operative-input deletion as a local productive-path diagnostic
summary: The prior 8192-case diagnostic and its exact counts are preserved in the linked actuality-esse note, Source-specific productive deletion. The conjectured loss-to-path implication now follows by classical contraposition and Supply induction. Even deleting the target as sole input cannot deprive it of original supply. In the application press, deleting drive-input groups loses this patient's imprint while all three bearer-esse supplies survive. Result 63dccec0 supplies CoveredAncestry from coherent covered losses and ownership. A positive named-work lower bound for one isolated stroke can independently warrant productive participation, subject to measured routing and adequate bounds on all other usable inputs. The formal conservation and application rows differ on mediated responsibility despite agreeing on actual occurrences. A missing path on incomplete records is no counterexample to universal transfer.
blocker: Particular source attribution still requires actual classification, ownership and adequate scope, temporal interpretation and the same external cause dictionary. The consumer also needs TargetCoverage. Giving bearer esse alone does not identify who gives or currently applies the operative profile. The earlier copied-die and independent-engraver comparison already distinguishes historical credit. The remaining test asks what identifies this producer's receipt of existence from the named giver as including receipt of the very power exercised on the patient. The division case in attempt f78f9ad3 poses the same question for a generator. See docs/notes/actuality-esse-research.md#what-selective-loss-establishes-2026-11-25-1934.

current_assessment.scope: Issue #1934, source-specific loss of supply for the same event and its use in the argument from covered ancestry to universal transfer.
current_assessment.assessment: Loss of an originally supplied token after deleting groups that use selected inputs entails a nonempty original path from some selected input. The press preserves all three bearers while losing the imprint. For the isolated stroke, independently warranted work and routing bounds would favor actual drive participation over the interlock-only account. The press supplies one case. Actual attribution still needs an interpretation of productive credit, and universal transfer needs coverage of the eligible respects.
current_assessment.next_test: The die comparison already separates copied geometry from independent engraving under stipulated histories. Seek evidence that this producer received from the named existential giver the very power exercised on this patient on this occasion. Historical credit and present application can come apart. Attempt f78f9ad3 poses this question at division.
